name: Hide the Pain Harold
look: Two stacked stock photos of an older man with white hair and a white beard, in a gray checked shirt, at a desk with a laptop and a pink mug. Top: he smiles at the screen. Bottom: he faces the camera with a strained, pained smile.
use: The top caption sets up something that seems fine and the bottom reveals the disappointment behind it, with his forced smile showing someone pretending everything is okay when it clearly is not.
examples: Me opening my bank app after a fun weekend
